annotations.title: Recommend agent skills for a project

description: Recommend agent skills (SKILL.md) that fit a coding project, for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot or Gemini CLI. Pass stack tags (best), a one line description, or a public GitHub repo URL. With no input it returns a sample for a Next.js project. Returns how many of 90,454 indexed skills fit, 2 free picks with license and install command, and a link to the full ranked list ($9 once). Read-only, no account.

description.description: One or two sentences about the project, for example "FastAPI service with Postgres, needs tests".

repo_url.description: Public GitHub repo URL. We read the file list and manifest files, nothing else.

tags.description: Stack and task tags from the project files, for example ["nextjs","supabase","stripe","testing"]. Tag names: call list_skill_tags.

name: recommend_skills
